program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture

authority.director_instruction: Work through individual sections of the already-completed app architecture before moving on, using the order that makes the most design sense.

question: Can Production Home / Resume be made implementation-usefully specific without reopening the frozen shell, turning Home into a Production-library dashboard, inventing Phase-D controls, or beginning final visual-language design?
inherited_law: The current Production and resume point dominate; other Productions remain subordinate.
Concise current situation, meaningful stakes and relevant recent movement support mental re-entry.
Light and Dark are co-equal semantic presentations.
Healthy persistence remains quiet; infrastructure exceptions never become fictional behavior.
Production cover/scenic imagery is not a requirement.

primary_hierarchy: Resume current work as the strongest action
Current Scene, what matters now, and recent relevant movement as supporting re-entry context
Other Productions / browse / create as subordinate switching paths
design_result.light_dark_parity: PASS - same hierarchy, commands and state meaning; styling remains provisional
design_result.imagery_requirement: NONE - no scenic/cover images are required by the section architecture
design_result.persistence_rule: healthy state quiet; recovery/read-only failure explicit outside fictional meaning
design_result.no_active_scene_rule: Production remains primary; exact next-Scene creation remains Product-defined
design_result.capability_failure_rule: technical unavailability never becomes Character silence/refusal or effective performance
design_result.responsive_order: current Production -> resume target -> current Scene -> what matters -> recent movement -> other Productions

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP via deterministic self-contained browser probe

first_visual_pass_findings: The label 'recent consequential movement' overclaimed causal/effective meaning for mixed re-entry activity.
The no-active-Scene helper sentence risked sounding like a frozen next-Scene creation command.
corrections: Changed the supporting block to 'recent relevant movement' and replaced inspection/audit-like examples with neutral relevant-change fixtures.
Changed the no-active-Scene text to state that exact next-Scene creation remains Product-defined.
recursive_audit.tooling_note: A combined forced-colors Edge launch once exited before DevToolsActivePort creation; isolated rerun passed with forced-colors active. Artifact bytes were unchanged.

non_authority: Final labels, icons, typography, palette, material and motion remain open.
Production imagery/cover art remains optional and unselected.
Exact Scene lifecycle and next-Scene creation controls remain Product-defined.
Consequence review, Perspective switching, Take/Rehearsal/branching, provider/model/cost, Performer assignment, portable Production and export workflows remain open.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail Production Shaping / Current Possibility inside the same frozen shell, preserving situation-first navigation and following meaningful elements into contextual/deep inspection.
